description: Long Binary (OLE) values around one page: inserts of 4075, 4076, 4077, 4080, 4081 and 9000 bytes into Lv, one per step. Asks where the single-page form ends and the chained form begins, and which pages each value takes. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it.
